name: hou_mcp_realization_audit
description: Tier 14.4.3 — Relationship Realization Audit. Verifies that relationship-aware transforms from the layout engine were correctly applied to Houdini nodes. Audits every asset against its relationship edge (supports / belongs_near / attached_to wall / attached_to ceiling) and reports per-asset findings. Hard Fail: any 'supports' relationship that results in floor placement (ty < 0.10m). Outputs relationship_realization_score, realized_edges, failed_edges, per_asset_findings, and production_ready. Pure planning — no bridge calls in this node; supply actual_transforms via transforms_json from HoudiniTransformFetcher or test injection.
python_code:
import json
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.layout import (
    get_relationship_realization_auditor,
    REALIZATION_AUDIT_PASS,
    REALIZATION_AUDIT_FAIL,
)
from src.runtime.layout_realization.transform_resolver import ResolvedTransform

class Hou_Mcp_Realization_Audit(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_realization_audit"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("transforms_json",    "string", widget_type="text", default="[]")
        self.add_input("node_path_map_json", "string", widget_type="text", default="{}")
        self.add_input("assets_json",        "string", widget_type="text", default="[]")
        self.add_input("shell_json",         "string", widget_type="text", default="{}")
        self.add_output("audit_json")
        self.add_output("relationship_realization_score", "float")
        self.add_output("realized_edges_json")
        self.add_output("failed_edges_json")
        self.add_output("per_asset_findings_json")
        self.add_output("status")
        self.add_output("production_ready", "bool")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        def _parse(raw, fallback):
            try:
                v = json.loads((raw or "").strip())
                return v if isinstance(v, type(fallback)) else fallback
            except Exception:
                return fallback

        transforms_raw    = inputs.get("transforms_json")    or "[]"
        node_path_map_raw = inputs.get("node_path_map_json") or "{}"
        assets_raw        = inputs.get("assets_json")        or "[]"
        shell_raw         = inputs.get("shell_json")         or "{}"

        transforms_list = _parse(transforms_raw,    [])
        node_path_map   = _parse(node_path_map_raw, {})
        assets          = _parse(assets_raw,         [])
        shell_dict      = _parse(shell_raw,          {})

        _EMPTY = {
            "audit_json":                    "{}",
            "relationship_realization_score": 0.0,
            "realized_edges_json":            "[]",
            "failed_edges_json":              "[]",
            "per_asset_findings_json":        "[]",
            "status":                         REALIZATION_AUDIT_FAIL,
            "production_ready":               False,
            "exec_out":                       True,
            "exec_out_fail":                  None,
        }

        try:
            # Reconstruct ResolvedTransform objects from JSON dicts
            planned: list = []
            for td in transforms_list:
                if not isinstance(td, dict):
                    continue
                rt = ResolvedTransform(
                    asset_id   = str(td.get("asset_id")   or ""),
                    asset_name = str(td.get("asset_name") or ""),
                    tx = float(td.get("tx", 0.0)),
                    ty = float(td.get("ty", 0.0)),
                    tz = float(td.get("tz", 0.0)),
                    rx = float(td.get("rx", 0.0)),
                    ry = float(td.get("ry", 0.0)),
                    rz = float(td.get("rz", 0.0)),
                    sx = float(td.get("sx", 1.0)),
                    sy = float(td.get("sy", 1.0)),
                    sz = float(td.get("sz", 1.0)),
                )
                # Attach relationship fields if present (Tier 14.4.3)
                rt.relationship = str(td.get("relationship") or "")
                rt.parent_id    = str(td.get("parent_id")    or "")
                planned.append(rt)

            # Fetch actual transforms from Houdini if node_path_map provided
            actual_transforms: dict = {}
            if node_path_map:
                try:
                    from src.runtime.layout import HoudiniTransformFetcher
                    actual_transforms = HoudiniTransformFetcher().fetch_transforms(
                        planned, node_path_map
                    )
                except Exception:
                    pass  # no bridge connection — audit will produce NO_DATA records

            # Room geometry from shell_json
            room_geometry = {
                "height": float(shell_dict.get("ceiling_height") or shell_dict.get("height") or 4.0),
                "width":  float(shell_dict.get("floor_width")    or shell_dict.get("width")  or 10.0),
                "depth":  float(shell_dict.get("floor_length")   or shell_dict.get("depth")  or 12.0),
            }

            result = get_relationship_realization_auditor().audit(
                planned_transforms = planned,
                actual_transforms  = actual_transforms,
                asset_metadata     = assets,
                room_geometry      = room_geometry,
            )

            d = result.to_dict()
            ok = result.production_ready

            return {
                "audit_json":                    json.dumps(d, sort_keys=True, indent=2),
                "relationship_realization_score": round(result.relationship_realization_score, 4),
                "realized_edges_json":            json.dumps(d.get("realized_edges", []), sort_keys=True, indent=2),
                "failed_edges_json":              json.dumps(d.get("failed_edges",   []), sort_keys=True, indent=2),
                "per_asset_findings_json":        json.dumps(d.get("per_asset_findings", []), sort_keys=True, indent=2),
                "status":                         result.status,
                "production_ready":               ok,
                "exec_out":                       True if ok else None,
                "exec_out_fail":                  True if not ok else None,
            }

        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"hou_mcp_realization_audit failed: {exc}")
            result = _EMPTY.copy()
            result["exec_out_fail"] = True
            result["exec_out"]      = None
            return result

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Realization_Audit
